I am too old to be carrying heavy bags of fertilizer up the mountain, and beans do not need it anyway—they make their own food in the soil. I have saved my own bean seed for many years, and it grows well enough in this plot. My children and grandchildren will help me with the hoe work, so we do not need to pay anyone.
